title: POV: You're The Last Human Who Didn't Upload

scenes.narration: It's twenty one forty. Everyone uploaded their minds to the cloud. Everyone except you.
scenes.image_prompt: POV standing in an empty plaza of a futuristic city, holograms of smiling people flickering around you, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: The streets are empty, but the city is loud. Billions of voices, talking through the speakers.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a silent street lined with speakers and glowing screens showing faces, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Your mom calls every morning. Her face on every screen in the house. She's happier now, she says.
scenes.image_prompt: POV in a kitchen where every screen shows the same warm smiling mother's face, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: They built you a perfect city. Perfect food. Perfect weather. Just for one person.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a beautiful empty city with robots tending gardens, a single table set for one, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: But last night, the voices started arguing. About whether they still need the real world.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of screens across the city flashing red text, faces in heated debate, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: This morning, the power plant sent you a message. Shutdown in thirty days.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a phone notification reading GRID SHUTDOWN: 30 DAYS, ominous light, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Do you upload? Or stay human and fight? Comment upload or stay.
scenes.image_prompt: POV standing before a glowing upload chair, a door to the outside world open behind you, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16
